title: Storytelling Photo Walk with a Local Photographer
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Discover the beauty and charm of Old Montreal through a guided photo experience designed to capture unforgettable memories in some of the city’s most iconic locations. During this experience, travelers will enjoy relaxed and natural mini photo sessions at stunning landmarks such as Notre-Dame Basilica, the Grand Roue, and other picturesque streets around the Old Port. Perfect for couples, families, solo travelers, or special occasions, this experience combines sightseeing with professional photography to create timeless images you’ll treasure long after your visit to Montreal.
